name: Delta SkyMiles Reserve Business American Express Card

localized_names.en: Delta SkyMiles Reserve Business American Express Card

apr.notes: APR not visible on product page; rates are behind a dynamically-loaded 'Rates & Fees' disclosure. See American Express for current APR.

base_rate.description: 1X mile on other purchases made using the Delta SkyMiles Reserve Business Card

categories.label: Eligible transit, U.S. shipping & U.S. office supply store purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Miles are Delta SkyMiles, redeemable for Award Travel on Delta flights. Take 15% off when booking Award Travel with miles on Delta flights via delta.com or Fly Delta app. Pay with Miles: up to $50 off the cost of your flight for every 5,000 miles redeemed when booking on delta.com.

benefits.title: Delta Sky Club Access
benefits.description: 15 Visits each Medallion Year to the Delta Sky Club when flying Delta, plus unlock Unlimited Delta Sky Club Access after spending $75,000 in purchases on your Card during a calendar year. Also receive four One-Time Guest Passes each Medallion Year.

benefits.title: Complimentary Access to The Centurion Lounge and Escape Lounge
benefits.description: Complimentary access to The Centurion Lounge (including Sidecar) and Escape Lounges when flying on a Delta flight booked with the Delta SkyMiles Reserve Business Card. Must arrive within 90 minutes of departing flight for Sidecar, within 3 hours for Centurion Lounge.

benefits.title: MQD Headstart
benefits.description: Receive $2,500 Medallion Qualification Dollars each Medallion Qualification Year. Silver Medallion Status can be reached by earning $5,000 MQDs.

benefits.title: MQD Boost
benefits.description: Earn $1 Medallion Qualification Dollar for each $10 of purchases made on your Card in a calendar year, boosting toward elevated Medallion Status.

benefits.title: Annual Companion Certificate
benefits.description: Companion Certificate each year after renewal of your Card for a Delta First, Delta Comfort, or Delta Main domestic, Caribbean, or Central American round-trip flight. Requires payment of government-imposed taxes and fees of between $22 and $250.

benefits.title: Check Two Bags Free
benefits.description: First checked bag flies free on international and domestic Delta flights. Second bag flies free on domestic Delta flights.

benefits.title: Take 15% Off Award Travel
benefits.description: Save 15% anytime you book Award Travel with miles on Delta flights when using delta.com and the Fly Delta app. Discount not applicable to partner-operated flights or to taxes and fees.

benefits.title: Upgrade Priority
benefits.description: Receive upgrade priority over others with your Medallion tier, product and fare experience purchased, and Million Miler milestone when you fly with Delta.

benefits.title: $240 Resy Credit
benefits.description: Earn up to $240 back in statement credits annually (up to $20 each month) at over 10,000 qualifying U.S. Resy restaurants after making eligible purchases on your enrolled Card.

benefits.title: $120 Rideshare Credit
benefits.description: Earn up to $10 back in statement credits each month on U.S. rideshare purchases with select providers after you pay with your Card. Up to $120 back annually. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: Up to $250 Delta Stays Credit
benefits.description: Annual statement credit of up to $250 after using your Card to book prepaid hotels or vacation rentals through Delta Stays on delta.com.

benefits.title: Hertz President's Circle Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Hertz President's Circle Status. Enrollment in Hertz Gold Plus Rewards required; add account number to SkyMiles account and enroll in promotion at delta.com/hertz.

benefits.title: Fee Credit for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck
benefits.description: Statement credit for a five-year membership every 4 years after applying for Global Entry ($120) or TSA PreCheck (up to $85) and paying the application fee with your Card.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: Enjoy international travel without additional fees on purchases made abroad.

benefits.title: Pay with Miles
benefits.description: Take up to $50 off the cost of your flight for every 5,000 miles you redeem with Pay with Miles when you book on delta.com.

benefits.title: 1.5X Miles After $150,000 Spend
benefits.description: After you spend $150,000 in purchases on your Card in a year, earn 1.5 miles on all eligible purchases for the rest of the year. If a purchase qualifies for a higher mileage accelerator, only the higher accelerator will apply.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Terms of the Original Manufacturer's Warranty can be extended up to one additional year. Applies to warranties of 5 years or less on Covered Purchases in the United States.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Protects covered purchases against theft, accidental damage, or loss for up to 90 days from purchase date. Up to $10,000 per Covered Purchase, up to $50,000 per calendar year.

benefits.title: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Reimbursed for repair or replacement of damaged or stolen cell phone up to $800 per claim, limit of 2 approved claims per 12-month period. $50 deductible per approved claim. Coverage provided by New Hampshire Insurance Company, an AIG Company.

benefits.title: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: If a round-trip is paid for entirely with your Eligible Card and a covered reason delays your trip more than 6 hours, reimburses certain additional expenses up to $500 per trip, maximum 2 claims per 12-month period. Coverage provided by New Hampshire Insurance Company, an AIG Company.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: If a round-trip is paid for entirely with your Eligible Card and a covered reason cancels or interrupts your trip, reimburses non-refundable travel expenses up to $10,000 per trip and up to $20,000 per Eligible Card per 12-month period. Coverage provided by New Hampshire Insurance Company, an AIG Company.

benefits.title: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Covered for lost, damaged, or stolen Baggage when purchasing Common Carrier Vehicle tickets on an Eligible Card. Up to $1,250 for carry-on Baggage and up to $500 for checked Baggage.

benefits.title: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Covered for Damage to or Theft of a Rental Vehicle when using Eligible Card to reserve and pay for the Entire Rental and declining CDW. Secondary coverage; does not include liability coverage.

lounge_access.notes: Delta Sky Club (15 visits/year, unlimited after $75K spend) + Centurion Lounge + Escape Lounges when flying Delta

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: First bag free on domestic and international Delta flights; second bag free on domestic Delta flights

notes: Delta SkyMiles Reserve Business Card. $650 annual fee. 3X miles at Delta, 1.5X on transit/shipping/office supply, 1X on other.
